_usage: Use these presets to quickly configure filtering behavior. Reference profiles in config.json or command-line arguments.

strict._comment: High quality only - for production environments where only proven, well-maintained skills are acceptable
strict._use_when: You prioritize stability and quality over discovery. Recommended for enterprise or critical systems.
strict._trade_offs: May miss emerging skills. Smaller result set.

similarity._threshold_rationale: 0.80 = very strict matching, reduces false positives

replacement._star_improvement_rationale: Replacement must have 1.5x stars of current skill

security._fail_rationale: Abort if critical security issues found

balanced._comment: Default settings - balanced between quality and discovery
balanced._use_when: General use. Good balance of quality filtering and result coverage.

replacement._star_improvement_rationale: Replacement must have equal or more stars

security._fail_rationale: Warn on critical issues but don't abort

permissive._comment: More inclusive - for exploration and discovery of emerging skills
permissive._use_when: You want to discover new/emerging skills. Willing to manually evaluate results.
permissive._trade_offs: More results but requires manual quality assessment. May include lower-quality skills.

quality._age_rationale: 12 months allows for stable but less frequently updated skills

similarity._threshold_rationale: 0.65 = more permissive matching, captures more alternatives

replacement._better_stars_rationale: Allow replacements with fewer stars if other factors strong
replacement._star_improvement_rationale: Replacement can have 20% fewer stars if compensated by recency/similarity

security._fail_rationale: Warn on all issues but don't abort

experimental._comment: Minimal filtering - for research and edge case exploration
experimental._use_when: Research purposes, exploring skill ecosystem comprehensively, or custom evaluation pipelines.
experimental._trade_offs: Very large result sets. Significant manual filtering required. May include abandoned/low-quality skills.
experimental._warning: Not recommended for production use without manual review

quality._stars_rationale: No star requirement - include all skills
quality._age_rationale: 24 months includes even rarely updated skills
quality._description_rationale: No description required - may include incomplete skills

replacement._better_stars_rationale: Stars not required for replacement consideration
replacement._star_improvement_rationale: Replacement can have significantly fewer stars

security._fail_rationale: Report all findings but never abort

use_cases._comment: Common use case to profile mapping

production_deployment.rationale: Production systems require proven, well-maintained skills with high quality standards

personal_development.rationale: Personal projects benefit from balance of quality and discovery

skill_discovery.rationale: Finding new skills requires more inclusive filtering to discover emerging tools

ecosystem_research.rationale: Research and analysis requires comprehensive coverage of skill landscape

security_audit.rationale: Security audits require high confidence in skill quality and maintenance

rapid_prototyping.rationale: Prototyping benefits from quick discovery of alternative solutions

method_2_manual_copy.example: Replace thresholds section in config.json with values from desired profile

method_3_command_line.note: Requires script modification to support --profile flag

method_4_environment.note: Requires script modification to read FILTER_PROFILE env var

profile_comparison._comment: Quick reference comparing key parameters across profiles

customization._comment: How to create your own custom profiles
tips: Start with balanced profile and adjust one parameter at a time
Lower thresholds increase result count but may reduce quality
Higher thresholds improve quality but may miss emerging skills
Test profiles with sample queries before deploying
